verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a Language Identification feature that automatically identifies the language in an audio file. Its pricing page also describes transcription across 56 languages "without choosing one up front," with mid-sentence language switching, so developers do not have to declare the language. missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuration and detection accuracy, explicit confirmation that auto-detection works for realtime streaming as well as batch files, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it

citations.quote: To automatically identify the language in an audio file, use the Language Identification feature.
Transcribes 56 languages without choosing one up front, switches language mid-sentence.
